name: Colton Duncan
current_role: White House liaison, U.S. Department of Labor (since March 2025)
summary: Colton Duncan, a political strategist and digital media entrepreneur from Lubbock, Texas, and a Turning Point USA alumnus, was president and CEO of Ninja Digital and a top aide to Kari Lake's 2022 Arizona governor campaign. The Labor Department named him its White House liaison in March 2025. In October 2022 he drew criticism, and calls from tribal leaders for Lake to fire him, for an Indigenous Peoples' Day post showing an image of human sacrifice; he made his account private, and the campaign and later the department did not respond to requests for comment.
